generator.name: FFmpeg lossless container remux
generator.recipe: ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostdin -v warning -n -i <source.mp4> -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0 -map_metadata -1 -c copy -avoid_negative_ts make_zero -flvflags no_metadata -fs 1073741824 -f flv <new-output.flv>. No cuts, looping, concatenation or re-encoding. Global metadata is omitted and timestamps shifted to make negative DTS nonnegative. Attribution is retained here. Source and FLV packet counts and per-stream SHA256 hashes were independently compared.
